task: J10b = J10 + proactively create the Application before the first activity so the NoTitle ActivityLifecycleCallbacks register and dispatch (design 3'). Fixes the J9/J10 NoTitle no-op.
deterministic: yes -- built twice in dockbuild a2hlab-b5-java:24.04, both cb392c96
root_of_j10_notitle_noop: route-A creates the Application lazily in stock performLaunchActivity->LoadedApk.makeApplicationInner, so ActivityThread.currentApplication()==mInitialApplication are null at nativeOnScheduleLaunchAbility; install() hit app==null and never registered (no [J10-NOTITLE] in knot hilog; [J10-ACTINFO] fired on the same channel). knot/dice both die on the action-bar ISE under U8 AND J10.

change.mechanism: schedule() posts to the main looper; bootstrap() does ActivityThread.getPackageInfoNoCheck(SelfComponentFallback.boundInfo()).makeApplicationInner(false, getInstrumentation()) -> set mInitialApplication (if null) -> registerActivityLifecycleCallbacks(NoTitle). makeApplicationInner creates/returns the cached Application and does NOT call onCreate (route-A calls onCreate once via its own path, so pre-create is transparent). route-A's stock performLaunchActivity then dispatches onActivityPreCreated to the NoTitle callback.
change.fallback: if makeApplicationInner is unreachable, bootstrap logs '[J10b] makeApplicationInner unavailable, fall back to design-1' and does nothing (board rolls back; then design-1 Instrumentation wrapper).

class_delta.note: J10's ACTINFO fix + the harmless J10 NoTitle no-op injection are retained unchanged.
